title: Dynamic bandgap modulation in CsPbBr3 perovskite nanocrystals through reversible ammonia intercalation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3562-3569
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07759H, Paper

Karayadi H. Fausia, Bijoy Nharangatt, Kavundath Muhsina, John P. Rappai, Raghu Chatanathodi, Deepthi Jose, Kulangara Sandeep
Exposure to ammonia vapors on CsPbBr3-coated substrates results in the widening of a semiconductor's bandgap, which is reversible with time. The intercalation NH3-induced strain origins the bandgap widening.
